body.description: a western diamondback rattlesnake coiled on the ground ready to strike: dusty tan scales with a chain of dark brown diamonds along its back, a broad flat head reared up, its black-and-white banded tail raised with the rattle at the end. no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
